test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 20 identical solid hemispheres of radius 3 cm are melted to form a big solid hemisphere. What is the radius (in cm) of the biggest hemisphere formed, if 20% of the solid is wasted during the process?
solution:
**Given:**

20 identical solid hemispheres of radius = 3 cm

20% of the solid is wasted during the process

**Formula used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2)/(3)pi r³

Total volume of 20 small hemispheres = {Volume of one hemisphere} times 20

Big solid hemisphere volume after 20% wastage = ({Total volume of 20 small hemispheres}) times 80\% 

Radius of the big hemisphere = sqrt[3]{frac{{Volume of big hemisphere} times 3}{2pi}}
